methodologyNotes: Self-serve USD pricing was collected from each vendor's official pricing page on 2026-06-14. All prices are per-release (one-time, non-recurring) unless noted. Because this is a per-release model, monthlyUsd reflects the smallest published per-release price for the lowest tier; there are no monthly subscriptions on most vendors. PR Newswire does not publish any self-serve pricing on its website (confirmed via prnewswire.com/products/ and contact page — pricing requires direct contact via phone 888-776-0942 or chat); this is independently confirmed by a 2026 HubSpot pricing roundup. Business Wire's website consistently timed out or returned no pricing page content (multiple URL attempts timed out at 60s); no self-serve pricing has been found and the HubSpot roundup corroborates 'tiered pricing based on distribution reach' with no published rates. GlobeNewswire and AccessWire pricing pages returned 403/404; no self-serve USD pricing could be confirmed and both are therefore omitted. All minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall fields are null on every plan (non-telephony product). annualDiscountPct is null for all vendors as none publish annual subscription pricing — all are per-release. billingModel is 'custom' for quote-only tiers with no flat rate, 'flat' for all fixed per-release prices.

vendors.name: PR Newswire
